measurements.notes: Composite: gas pipeline 1.42 km (65% weight), GHI 3.98 kWh/m2/day (35% weight). Wind and land-for-generation components not yet implemented — index is therefore conservative. Solar/wind cannot firm a data center load; counted here only for a hybrid or bridging strategy.
Design wet-bulb (0.4% exceedance) 25.4 C; mean 10.4 C. Computed from 10 yr of ERA5 hourly reanalysis via Stull (2011).

Distance only — treated flow capacity must be confirmed with the operator. Reclaimed water is usually the highest score-per-dollar water intervention available: it neutralizes most community opposition and is often cheaper than potable.
7272 h/yr below 24.0 C. Design dry-bulb 34.7 C. Indicative PUE 1.138 — a screening proxy, not a CFD-grade model.

MODELED, NOT PROJECTED: linear extrapolation of the observed 30-year trend in annual design-day temperature (+0.069 C/yr). This is a placeholder for NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 and should not be cited as a climate projection.

measurements.notes: SCREENING ESTIMATE ONLY. suburban (210 buildings/km2) within 5.0 km; assumed 16% developable. This is an upper bound on physically developable land and a much looser upper bound on ACQUIRABLE land — parcel fragmentation typically cuts it by half or more. Confirm against cadastral data before any decision.

1 power plant(s) within 8 km; nearest Panda Stonewall (Potomac Energy) Power Plant (gas) at 4.98 km. CHECK RETIREMENT STATUS — a retiring plant is the highest-value site category available, because interconnection rights, transmission, water rights and often the land itself are already in place.

Nearest interconnection facility 'RagingWire VA3 - NTT' at 3.1 km; 93 facilities within 100 km. Weight this near zero for a training campus — over-weighting it biases site selection toward expensive metro land.

970 network presences across 81 facilities within 50 km. Network presences at carrier-neutral facilities are a proxy for carrier availability, not a direct count of carriers able to serve this parcel.
OSM telecom route coverage is sparse and inconsistent worldwide. Tier C even when a route is found. Confirm with carriers or a paid route dataset.

1133 estimated dwellings from 1100 OSM residential features within 1.0 km. Apartment blocks estimated at 4 units/level. Noise from chillers and generator testing is the most common specific complaint in data center opposition — distance is the cheapest mitigation.
Read together with lnd.heavy_haul_access: a nearby port is worthless if the final approach cannot carry a 300-tonne transformer. OSM port tagging is inconsistent; treat as screening-grade.

gates.reason: Substation available capacity is unknown — the most common cause of late-stage project failure. Verify with the utility before committing capital.

gates.name: Water viability for the assumed cooling architecture

gates.remediation_hint: Switch to air-cooled or closed-loop (costs 10-30% more power), or secure reclaimed water.

hyperscale_training.headline: Not yet — and the reason is missing evidence, not a bad site. 8 knockout checks cannot be evaluated at all because the factor each one reads is unmeasured; the regulatory domain has no data at all and drops out of the score; 18 unmeasured factors could each move the verdict across a threshold on its own; only 25% of the decision weight is measured. Profitability in particular is unanswerable here: 5 of 5 cost inputs are unmeasured (Modeled 10-year TCO, Industrial retail power price, Large-load tariff availability, Land acquisition cost, Tax incentive package), so the score is a suitability screen, not a return. The verification queue is ordered by how much of the decision each answer settles.
hyperscale_training.profitability_basis: 5 of 5 cost inputs are unmeasured (Modeled 10-year TCO, Industrial retail power price, Large-load tariff availability, Land acquisition cost, Tax incentive package), so the score is a suitability screen, not a return.

blockers.title: Nothing measured in regulatory — all 7 factors dark
blockers.why: This domain carries weight 8 of 57 in this profile and has no values at all, so it is excluded from the score: the headline number is a weighted mean over the 7 domains that do have data, not over all 8. It also holds the input to 1 knockout check(s), which are therefore being decided blind.
blockers.resolve: Dispatch the regulatory analyst. Highest-swing factor in the domain is Accelerator export control exposure at 14 points.

blockers.title: Substation available capacity is unmeasured, and Credible power path to target load depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 8 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Load-serving study or written statement of available capacity at the named substation, for the named load, in the named year.

blockers.title: Interconnection queue time to energization is unmeasured, and Credible power path to target load depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 8 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Queue position and cluster study schedule for a comparable request
blockers.owner: ISO/RTO interconnection queue, then the utility

blockers.title: Organized opposition risk is unmeasured, and No active data center moratorium depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 7 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Outcome of every data center application heard in this jurisdiction since 2023
blockers.owner: Public record — planning commission and board minutes

blockers.title: Baseline water stress is unmeasured, and Water viability for the assumed cooling architecture depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 6 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Will-serve letter or withdrawal permit precedent

blockers.title: Riverine and pluvial flood exposure is unmeasured, and Flood exclusion depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 6 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Site-specific study; global rasters are screening-grade only

blockers.title: Water rights and withdrawal permitting is unmeasured, and Water viability for the assumed cooling architecture depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 6 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Permit precedent for comparable industrial withdrawal in the same basin

blockers.title: Coastal flood and sea level rise exposure is unmeasured, and Flood exclusion depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 5 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Site-specific study; global rasters are screening-grade only

blockers.title: Protected area and habitat overlap is unmeasured, and Protected area exclusion depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 3 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Zoning determination letter and title/survey

blockers.title: Modeled 10-year TCO is unmeasured
blockers.why: Resolving this moves the score by up to 8 points, straddling the boundary between 'viable' and 'strong-candidate' — the verdict is not determined by the evidence on hand.
